exclusion_reason: The DXBC/DXIL frontend prototype is implemented: a bounded reader parses the DXBC chunk table, locates the SHDR/SHEX or DXIL chunk, and emits a complete named-opcode coverage table where every encountered shader-model 4/5 opcode is named and one the prototype cannot lower is named-blocked by its numeric identity, never dropped; a DXIL chunk is named as an unresolved bitcode-lowering surface. This is prototype-only ([P4]): the container is read and the opcode surface is enumerated, but no Direct3D 10-12 program is lowered into the unified representation, which is the red half of this item.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the prototype reader consumes the research fixture and emits a complete named-opcode coverage table.
expected_failing_assertion: A Direct3D 10-12 program lowers from DXBC/DXIL into the unified representation and renders on a live adapter.
active_gate_evidence: The shader suite proves the DXBC prototype reader parses the container, emits a complete named-opcode coverage table (every opcode named, unsupported ones named-blocked by numeric identity), names DXIL bitcode as blocked, and refuses a non-DXBC or truncated container.
procedure: Run the prototype reader over the DXBC and DXIL research fixture.
Emit the opcode coverage table with unsupported opcode named.
Record the reuse decision for the prior-art chain.
pass_criterion: Every opcode is covered or named unsupported.
The prior-art reuse decision is recorded.
